text:
```yaml
name: Duplicate Issue Detection

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]

permissions:
  issues: write

jobs:
  detect-duplicates:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Detect potential duplicates
        uses: wow-actions/potential-duplicates@v1
        with:
          threshold: 90
          label: potential-duplicate
          comment: "Potential duplicate detected. Similar issues: {{similar_issues}}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
yaml:
name: Duplicate Issue Detection

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]

permissions:
  issues: write

jobs:
  detect-duplicates:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Detect potential duplicates
        uses: wow-actions/potential-duplicates@v1
        with:
          threshold: 90
          label: potential-duplicate
          comment: "Potential duplicate detected. Similar issues: {{similar_issues}}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
